**Finding: COMPLIANT** (preferred position) — no redline proposed.

The Agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, guaranteed volume or shortfall mechanic binding the Company:

- **§3.1** — fees are a pure revenue share (30% of Net Sales), and only on Net Sales *above* $11,000 per month. Payment is entirely contingent on actual sales generated, which is the preferred "usage or ordered services only" position.
- **§3.3** — the only adjustment mechanic is a quarterly reconciliation for refunds and exchanges, i.e. a true-up operating in our favour, not a penalty.
- **§4.1** — the Company has an annual exit on 90 days' notice, so even if a commitment existed it would be term-limited with a termination right.

Two adjacent items noted in the rationale but deliberately not flagged here (to avoid double-counting the same commercial term under two rules):

1. **§4.2 Termination Payment** (trailing 12-month Net Sales less $800,000, halved, payable in 8 quarterly instalments) — this is an exit fee keyed to past performance, not a volume commitment or shortfall charge. It belongs under the termination-fee rule.
2. **§6.1 Exclusivity** — restricts the Company from similar online projects for Deerskin Products, but imposes no volume floor or cap on Company usage. It belongs under the exclusivity rule.
